Content Service
Redis Distributed Lock
Friend Service
Content DB
Semantic Discovery Engine
ref
Remaining items in session drop below low-watermark threshold
Acquire distributed Redis refill lock (60-second TTL)
Lock acquired
Query viewer friend network and audience exclusions
Return blocked author IDs and audience filters
Query viewer interest profile and recently viewed reel IDs
Return viewer affinity tags and seen history
Retrieve candidate reels matching interest tags
Return candidate pool with engagement scores
Score and rank candidates,filtering previously seen reels
Append ranked reels to session cache and mark refill complete
Release distributed Redis refill lock
ref
Session refilled in background; upcoming page requests continue uninterrupted
